analysis.dose_lag_witness: L(t)=beta*delta*[1-exp(-t/tau)] through relax. Dose/coefficient rescaling (delta/scale,beta*scale,tau) preserves the trajectory. Lag/coefficient rescaling (delta,beta*[1-exp(-1/tau)]/[1-exp(-1/(scale*tau))],scale*tau) preserves year1 but changes year2.
analysis.endpoint_witness: Normalize existing synthetic H/IR shares, D0=0. A=(a,r,d/scale), pA=dA/(rA+dA)*[-expm1(-(rA+dA))]. B has gB=scale*(rA+dA), dB=pA*gB/[-expm1(-gB)], rB=gB-dB, unchanged a. C changes only a to scale*a. Test same year1 D entry, different endpoint stocks/year2 entries, conservation and analytic arithmetic.
analysis.limitation: Counterexamples concern the isolated implemented annual survivor operator and synthetic dietary response. They are not formal identifiability results for the trial multi-year adjusted Cox likelihood; the source HR is never used as a one-year risk ratio or input to these witnesses.
analysis.null: Identical hazards reproduce reference output; zero response gives multiplier one. Mathematical hypotheses, not observed zero clinical effects.
analysis.uncertainty: Fixed mathematical/software witnesses; not clinical estimates or clinical uncertainty distributions.
analysis.units: hazards per year; lag/time in years; normalized expected person counts and dimensionless log-response
